headline: Nevish Line Still Boils as Weathered Expanse Colours Shift
war_summary: The Nevish Line's colours are unchanged since the last edition — six Warden works to two Colonial — but the fighting there has thickened rather than eased: fifty-seven actions in the past day, twelve of them inside two hours, with Princefal, Blackcoat Way and Grief Mother the busiest points and the latest report arriving as this edition goes to press. In Weathered Expanse the ledger has shifted again; the expanse, then five Colonial, one Warden and three unclaimed, now reads three Colonial, two Warden and four unclaimed, after fifty-two actions in the day, Crow's Nest, Shattered Advance and Wightwalk the storm centres. Marban Hollow holds at four Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed through thirty-two actions about Checkpoint Bua, while Kuura Strand's tangle at Faden Point continues, thirty-eight actions in the day. Linn Mercy stands nine Colonial, one Warden and one unclaimed, its weight on Lathair. The Dead Lands reports the war's heaviest and still-mounting casualty tolls without a single change of colours; Callahan's Passage, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle likewise bleed heavily.
